ns2:course.label: Introduction to Energy Sources
ns2:course.description: Explanation of energy technologies using an elementary approach presupposing no prior scientific or technical background. Coverage of all energy sources including fossil fueled, solar, hydro, and nuclear power. Integral demonstrations and a tour of the University's power plant. Discussion of energy related incidents with emphasis on environmental, economic, and social impact. Credit is not given for both GCL 101 and NPRE 101.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both GCL 101 and NPRE 101.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Sustainability, Physical Sciences, and Quant Reasoning II course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
